Exam 2

Work

P1. Determine the work necessary to push a mass of 66.5 kg a distance of 2.6 m by a force of 73.8 N.  (191.88 J)

P2. Find the work lifting 1.5 kg up 1.1 m. The gravitational acceleration is g = 9.8 m/s2. (16.17 J)

P3. A luggage handler pulls a 24-kg suitcase up a ramp inclined at 29˚ above the horizontal. The coefficient of kinetic friction is μk = 0.36. Find the work done by friction over 3.1 m. (-240.5 J)

P4. A luggage handler pulls a 18-kg suitcase up a ramp inclined at 31° above the horizontal. The coefficient of kinetic friction is μk = 0.32. Find the work done by gravity over 4.1 m. (372.496 J)

Kinetic energy

P5. A meteor had a mass of 1.6×108 kg and hit the ground at 12 km/s. How much kinetic energy did it deliver? (1.152E+16 J)

P6. An electron has kinetic energy 4.3×10⁻¹⁶ J. Two masses M₁ = 9.5 kg and M2 = 3 kg. A velocity (2iˆ+ 2jˆ) m/s. What fraction is lost?

(0.16)

P7. 4 cars couple with a 5th car until the speed is 1/6 of the initial speed. Assume that U(0)=0. How many cars are there? (24)
